caption: The drawing features a maritime scene with a prominent old-fashioned sailing ship with multiple sails, masts, and rigging depicted in white and light brown tones, sailing on dark blue and green waves against a bright blue sea and sky. To the left, there is a tall, cylindrical lighthouse with arched windows, from which rocks and shrubbery extend to the base. To the right, another smaller sailboat in similar colors is visible on the water. Several white birds are seen flying above the smaller sailboat on the right. The words "SANDY-HOOK" are written in red uppercase letters near the upper right quadrant of the image. At the very top, there is a decorative horizontal border with a floral and leaf motif in shades of yellow, mustard, olive green, brown, and red. The drawing is signed "ISABELLA RUTH DORFLER" in small capital letters in the lower right corner. The overall color palette consists mainly of blues, whites, browns, and greens, with touches of red and yellow in the decorative border.
title: Bandbox Design
